osaka_wakitaya_nishitenma.notes: [Izakaya · 西天満, charcoal-grilled horumon] A small counter izakaya between Kitashinchi and Nishitenma, open since 2017, where the owner grills horumon, yakiton and yakitori over charcoal and makes the sauces. Start with the wagyu horumon of small intestine and the beef tataki yukhoe, then work through heart, shiro-maru and tongue; small portions make it easy to eat alone. Prices are low for the area, around ¥3,000–4,000 a head. Busy with office workers after work; smoking is allowed.

osaka_kayou_nishiumeda_dojima.notes: [Japanese · Dojima, Shiga's vegetables from the farm] A forty-seat Japanese restaurant in Dojima run by a Shiga company that grows its own vegetables in Moriyama and trucks in produce from local farms each day. The signature is an all-you-can-eat 'Omi vegetable' salad, served in a flowerpot and dressed from a watering can at the table. Dinner courses from ¥4,000 add an Omi chicken hotpot or Omi beef sukiyaki, red konnyaku, tempura and seasoned rice; the ¥1,210 lunch set comes with free refills of salad and rice. Open daily, non-smoking, with private rooms.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: an Omi-vegetable restaurant supplied direct from the company's own farm in Moriyama, Shiga, and more than 300 local farmers growing over 100 varieties; four trucks collect from producers each morning; Omi beef bought whole; Lake Biwa fish. The Tabelog invoice number T5160001016157 is registered to 株式会社ガーデン, 守山市 (NTA invoice register, read 2026-11-02).

Visitors to Osaka staying nearby come for a first taste of kushikatsu; smoking is allowed.

osaka_serena_hotel_nikko.notes: [Buffet · Shinsaibashi, Hotel Nikko Osaka's café over Midosuji] The all-day buffet café on the second floor of Hotel Nikko Osaka, right on Shinsaibashi Station, with windows over Midosuji. Families come back every year; one diner found dishes slow to be replenished and the mapo tofu not spicy. Open 6:45–21:00.

osaka_hariju_grill_dotonbori.notes: [Yoshoku · Dotonbori, the wagyu house's Showa-era grill] The Western-style dining room of Hariju, the 1919 kuroge-wagyu house at the Dotonbori entrance, next to its sukiyaki rooms and curry shop. It is old-school yoshoku made with heifer wagyu: a beef cutlet from tenderloin, hamburg steak, beef or tongue stew and hayashi rice, or lunch plates of thin steak and fried shrimp with onion soup. Diners in 2026 loved the beef cutlet, tongue stew and retro room; others found the steak thin, tough or lukewarm for the price, a beef stew that tasted thawed, or a staff member brusque. Closed Tuesdays (except holidays and December).

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: a Western-style restaurant run by Hariju, the kuroge wagyu specialist in Dotonbori, established in 1919; it uses only female kuroge wagyu, and its traditional dishes have long been loved by all ages and nationalities. The group's sukiyaki house (osaka_harijyu_dotonbori) and curry shop (osaka_harijyu_curry_shop_dotonbori) are in data; a September 2026 diner also buys bento at the butcher counter.
chef_bio.specialty: Beef cutlet; heifer-wagyu steak with week-long demi-glace.

Reservations online at any time; for 7 or more, phone (Tabelog). Entry needs free registration in the Takumi fan club (a LINE friend), also possible at the door (Tabelog). One drink per person at lunch (August 2026).
osaka_kodawari_kome_takumi_nishinakajima.notes: [Yakiniku · Nishinakajima-Minamigata, wagyu from the group’s own farm and rice cooked for your table] A 52-seat meat izakaya along the tracks five minutes from Nishinakajima-Minamigata, in Tabelog’s Yakiniku 100 for 2023 and a Hot Restaurant in 2025 and 2026. The Takumi group raises its own Oita wagyu, and the ¥5,000–7,000 courses run from seared beef sushi and thick tongue to sukiyaki-style kalbi laid on rice; the rice itself is the other star, cooked in a clay pot for each table, with what you leave made into onigiri to take home (2026). Register free with the group’s LINE fan club to enter. Open to 23:00; lunch at weekends.

roles: Kitchen and grill staff of the 匠 group (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per the group site (takumi.farm, read 2026-11-02): the 匠 group began with a barbecue business in 2010, now runs its own farm, restaurants in Nishinakajima (焼肉匠 本店, 大衆肉酒場こだわり米匠, 個室焼肉匠, ニュー焼肉食堂匠, 黒毛和牛研究所 and 豆皿おばんざい匠, opened 15 September 2026) and mail order; 15th anniversary in 2026. Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: Tabelog Yakiniku WEST 100 in 2023; Hot Restaurant 2025 and 2026; "the Takumi Group has returned to its roots ... the most important thing we must cherish at all times is our fans and customers", hence the fan-club entry. Per reviews: "Following the staff’s recommendation ... I chose the JPY 5,000 course" (October 2026); "[the staff] kindly explained the menu and recommended dishes" (September 2026); "the staff kindly made the leftovers into onigiri for us" (October 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Yakiniku "with white rice", as the name Kodawari Kome (particular about rice) says (Tabelog; September 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Oita wagyu courses with clay-pot rice.

anecdotes.text: "They serve a blend of the varieties Yume Shizuku and Tsuki Akari, which I initially thought was a bit too soft, but after some time, it became just right." — September 2026, ¥7,000 course.
"The moment it melts in your mouth, it feels like ice cream or butter dissolving." — September 2026, the large grilled beef sushi.
"I usually dislike fatty meat, but I was able to enjoy it until the end without feeling sick." — October 2026.

osaka_koshitsu_yakiniku_takumi_nishinaka.notes: [Yakiniku · Nishinakajima-Minamigata, wagyu over charcoal in small private rooms] The 匠 group’s private-room yakiniku, tucked at the back of a building four minutes from Nishinakajima-Minamigata, where small rooms with sliding doors each have a charcoal shichirin (2026). The signature is a torch-seared yukhoe wrapped in egg yolk and laid on pot-cooked rice; tongue comes four ways, and the yuzu-scented grilled horumon is unlike other places, say regulars. Order the rice early, as it takes 15 minutes. Rooms are snug and can get warm. Two-hour seating; open to 23:00, from noon at weekends.

roles: Grill staff of the 匠 group (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: private-room yakiniku, sukiyaki and sushi; opened 9 June 2016. One of the 匠 group’s restaurants in Nishinakajima (takumi.farm, read 2026-11-02). Per reviews: "No matter which location of the Takumi group I visit, the food is always delicious and offers exceptional value!" (August 2026); "The staff were all very pleasant" (August 2026); "the green onions were served separately rather than on top of the raw meat, showing the restaurant’s consideration" (August 2026); one diner found it pricey for the taste (September 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Grilled yukhoe with egg yolk; charcoal-grilled horumon.

anecdotes.text: "Although it’s called yukhoe, it’s served rare, lightly grilled, and wrapped in egg—absolutely delicious!" — May 2026.
"The seared horumon had a unique flavor infused with yuzu, unlike anything I’ve tasted elsewhere." — August 2026, wagyu indulgence course.
"The rice takes about 15 minutes to prepare, so it’s best to order it early." — September 2026.

osaka_makino_maki_nishinakajima.notes: [Izakaya · Nishinakajima-Minamigata, Hakata vegetable-roll skewers until 1 a.m.] A 26-seat skewer bar three minutes from Nishinakajima-Minamigata, grilling Hakata-style vegetable rolls over charcoal: lettuce wrapped in pork belly as big as a fist, Hakata green onion, shiso and pea shoots, with yakitori alongside (2026). Skewers can be ordered one at a time from about ¥400–500, and a ¥1,100 all-you-can-drink keeps a night to around ¥3,000–4,500 (2026). Sesame kanpachi and a kamameshi to finish are the other favourites. Lively and usually booked out; smoking allowed. Open to 1:00.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: izakaya with yakitori and kushiyaki; opposite Yakiniku Hyakuban. Per reviews: "They serve vegetable rolls that became popular in Hakata, Kyushu, and now you can find them all over the country" (August 2026); "The restaurant was lively and always packed" (September 2026); "there were many young staff members" (October 2026); a wall menu adds items missing from the printed menu (September 2026); seasoning on the vegetable skewers can be strong (September 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Pork-wrapped lettuce rolls and other vegetable-roll skewers.

anecdotes.text: "I was surprised by how large it was—about the size of my fist!" — October 2026, lettuce-wrapped pork.
"All the pork rolls are delicious!! Especially the Hakata green onions—they’re exquisite!!" — July 2026.
"It’s great that you can order from just one skewer! Since each order comes with 2 to 3 pieces, sharing one skewer allows you to try a variety of flavors!" — October 2026.

osaka_casablanca_higashimikuni.notes: [Izakaya · Higashi-Mikuni, a couple’s fish house with rare sake and dry curry, since 1994] A 25-seat izakaya in a quiet street four minutes from Higashi-Mikuni, run since 1994 by a couple, that looks like an old coffee shop from outside. The owner’s family runs a fish shop, and the sashimi platter of up to nine kinds is the reason to come; simmered turban shell, fugu in winter and firefly squid in spring follow, with crab croquettes and roast beef from the Western side. The sake list runs to Aramasa and Juyondai, and everyone finishes with the dry curry (¥1,000, 2024). Cash only; closed Wednesday and Thursday; book ahead.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: izakaya, seafood and yoshoku; particular about fish and sake; opened 8 May 1994. Per reviews: "The couple running the restaurant seemed quite busy" and a rare shellfish sashimi "thanks to the father’s recommendation" (May 2024); "apparently the owner’s family runs a fish shop" (December 2024); "It’s run by a couple, and [the couple] seem to manage reservations by only taking a few groups at a time" (August 2025); "run by a lovely couple" and mostly locals or regulars (June 2026); the dry curry is by "someone who has researched the art of curry to perfection" (August 2024).
chef_bio.specialty: Sashimi platter; dry curry; rare sake.

anecdotes.text: "At first glance, it seems like any typical izakaya in a small town, but the quality of the fish [the shop serves] is outstanding!" — October 2024.
"The kasujiru made with Kizakiyama sake was luxurious." — February 2025.
"Sashimi - Recommended assorted platter of 9 types → Outstanding freshness! Luxurious!" — May 2025.

osaka_warayaki_sumi_hide_higashimikuni.notes: [Izakaya · Higashi-Mikuni, katsuo seared over straw at the counter] A fish izakaya opened in 2024 two minutes from Higashi-Mikuni Station, where the show is the warayaki: thick katsuo seared over blazing straw in view of the counter, smoky outside and rare inside, eaten with coarse salt and sudachi (2026). Lunch is a bargain at ¥1,650, warayaki with four obanzai, rice, soup and a small dessert, and fills after noon, so book (September 2026). At night add the sashimi of the day and fried dishes, with a good sake list; about ¥5,000–7,000 a head (2026). Closed Sunday; lunch Monday, Wednesday, Friday and Saturday only.

chef_bio.background: No shop description on Tabelog; opened 18 September 2024 (Tabelog). Reviewers: "The master was a wonderful person too!" (August 2026); lively staff and a calm room (September 2026).

anecdotes.text: "Watching the bonito being grilled over the blazing straw right in front of us at the counter got me excited even before tasting it." — August 2026, katsuo warayaki set meal.
"The thick cuts of fish were luxurious, with a perfect balance between the fragrant aroma of the grilled straw on the surface and the moist, rare texture inside." — September 2026.
"I recommend making a reservation since it gets fully booked after 12 PM!" — September 2026, warayaki lunch for JPY 1,650.

osaka_sakana_ryori_anono_higashimikuni.notes: [Fish · Higashi-Mikuni, a ¥1,650 fish set with ten obanzai] A small fish restaurant opened in 2024 down an alley near Higashi-Mikuni Station, whose lunch sells out every day: the ¥1,650 Anono Gozen of sashimi, grilled fish, kara-age, omelette and about ten homemade obanzai, like a ryokan breakfast (2026). Book by phone, or queue before noon with your whole party. It stays open into the evening for a sashimi platter with nine little dishes, ¥2,800, and drinks; a noon-to-mid-afternoon drinking session for two came to ¥8,000 (2026). Closed Sunday and holidays.

chef_bio.background: No shop description on Tabelog; opened 21 March 2024 (Tabelog). Reviewers: a homely room with many regulars at the counter (October 2026); attentive staff (July 2026); featured on a local TV programme (August 2026).

anecdotes.text: "The set meal included sashimi, grilled fish, small side dishes, rolled omelet, miso soup, and rice, all beautifully prepared, resembling a luxurious breakfast at a ryokan." — July 2026.

Smoking allowed; English menu; closed Tuesdays.
